newsitem.title: USA: Medical Tech units emerge from Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Medical Tech units emerge from Chapter 11.

text.p: Medical Technology Systems Inc said Monday its subsidiaries emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.
The company said the plans of reorganization for its major operating subsidiaries were confirmed on September 4.
The company said the units filed Chapter 11 cases earlier this year in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Middle District of Florida, Tampa Division.
The plans were approved without objection and by an overwhelming vote of secured and unsecured creditors.
The company said an integral part of the successful reorganization was the restructuring of the company's loan agreement with SouthTrust Bank of Alabama NA.

The company's $28 million credit facility with SouthTrust has been restructured to provide for, among other things, a $15 million performing loan with terms that facilitate growth in the operations of the company's core businesses, it said.
The SouthTrust debt will be fully satisfied upon payment of the principal balance of $15 million.
